items.rationale: Glazing breakage (2.1(e)) is optional and nothing shows it as agreed; 2.6.4 and 3.5(a) exclude the glazing element from accidental damage cover.
Preparatory drilling is glazing work under 1.3 and excluded by 3.5(b) where the glazing peril is not agreed.

items.description: Installation of the new glass into the frame
items.rationale: Setting and fitting of the pane is glazing work, excluded by 3.5(b); as an ancillary charge it follows the non-covered principal item (7.1.11).
Removal and disposal of the broken element is glazing work (3.5(b)); 5.2.1 does not extend debris removal to an item whose damage is not covered.

items.description: Repair of dented solid-wood side table
items.rationale: Sudden accidental damage (2.6.1) to household movable property, a separate affected item under 2.6.2; necessary repair cost incl. refinishing under 7.1.1(b), priced at an ordinary market level in line with the timber repairs in reference Case 3.

items.description: Touch-up of pre-existing scratches on second cabinet
items.rationale: Pre-existing condition on an item the event did not damage; excluded by 3.6(a), 3.6(b) and 7.1.9.
One attendance per undertaking is payable in full under 7.1.12 because the covered side-table repair was carried out at that visit; modest call-out price assumed.
A return visit by the same undertaking for the same event is not separately indemnified under 7.1.12 without prior agreement by the insurer.
General administrative charge is business overhead, not a repair cost, and is excluded by 7.1.8(b).
